    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CdcEnvelope
    The top-level JSON structure sent by CockroachDB's webhook sink.
    CdcEvent
    A decoded, application-facing change event: the raw CdcPayload with its Operation classified.
    CdcEventDecoder
    Parses CockroachDB changefeed webhook bodies into CdcEnvelopes and decodes their payloads into application-facing CdcEvents.
    CdcEventHandler
    Processes a batch of decoded CDC events from a single webhook delivery.
    CdcPayload
    A single row change within a changefeed webhook delivery, as emitted by CockroachDB's wrapped JSON envelope.
    ChangefeedBuilder
    Fluent builder for a CockroachDB CREATE CHANGEFEED statement.
    ChangefeedHandlerRegistry
    Routes decoded CdcEvents to per-table CdcEventHandlers.
    ChangefeedInfo
    Metadata about a changefeed job created via ChangefeedManager.
    ChangefeedManager
    Creates and controls CockroachDB changefeed jobs over a DataSource.
    ChangefeedWebhookHandler
    Receives CockroachDB changefeed webhook POSTs, parses the envelope, and dispatches decoded events to a ChangefeedHandlerRegistry.
    Operation
    The type of row change carried by a CDC event.
